newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy PM favours INA, BNL group.
newsitem.headline: Italy PM favours INA, BNL group.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi said he hoped Banca Nazionale del Lavoro and insurer INA could help form a major banking group to reinforce the Italian finance sector.
Recently privatised INA and state controlled BNL have put in a joint bid for 60 percent of struggling Banco di Napoli, which is currently in the hands of the Treasury.
Prodi told reporters the Treasury was looking for BNL, INA and Banco di Napoli to link up.
"It's clear that this can't be an isolated plan, but one which reinforces the whole Italian banking system," Prodi said.
"I hope that this plan can be carried forward to give Italy a strong banking and financial system...we need a few institutes which are capable of being world players," he added.
The Treasury said last week that state-owned credit institute Mediocredito Centrale had also bid for Banco di Napoli, but most people expect the INA-BNL axis to win.
A final decision is expected by January 20. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
